g.text: Porting VPD §4.3: do components interact through the QK circuit?

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: VPD decomposes W_QK = Σ_{c,c'} over subcomponent PAIRS. Their components are rank-1 so that term is a scalar; ours are not, but the

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: decomposition is still exact, and the pair strength generalises to ‖A_Q,c^T R_τ A_K,c'‖_F = √tr(R^T G_Q R G_K), which reduces to VPD's

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: quantity at rank 1. Measured over all 16×32 heads and 13 RoPE offsets: the interaction is overwhelmingly BETWEEN components, matching

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: VPD's finding that circuits are not contained in one subcomponent — but ablation finds no synergy, so the pairing is not causally load-bearing.
